items.title: SK Hynix to invest $38 billion building new memory chip plants as demand soars
items.description: Memory prices have surged because of short supply and huge demand with investors watching closely for any changes to the supply-demand imbalance.

items.title: Volkswagen controlling families call for faster overhaul to fend off Chinese rivals

items.title: Europe’s wildfire ‘protection gap’ is growing, insurers warn

items.title: China's exports growth beats estimates in July, as AI-driven shipments surge
items.description: China's exports rose more than expected in July, as global demand for high-tech components continues to absorb the country's manufactured goods.

items.description: News of Iran's restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz sent oil prices higher, renewing concerns over supply disruptions.

items.title: A 'weaponized' yen: How the U.S.-Japan intervention may reshape global currency markets
